exposure: maternal age: under 19, 20-35 and over 35 years
outcome: premature birth and low birth weight
cohort: 1212 women in childbirth and 1212 live-born babies after single pregnancies
finding: Maternal pelvic size abnormalities, breech presentation, placental abnormalities and caesarean birth increased the risk of preterm birth and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth increased the risk of preterm birth and low birth weight.
